scope: Tools visible in the current ChatGPT session, plus dynamic resources discovered via api_tool.list_resources.
important_notes: Input schemas are taken from the currently visible tool definitions and the api_tool resource listing.
Return schemas are descriptive summaries when the tool definition exposes only `any` or when the exact backend return object is not specified.
Some tools are channel-constrained in the assistant runtime; that constraint is included as metadata because it matters for actual use.
Dynamic api_tool resource paths include session-specific link identifiers and may change in another session.

top_level_tools.description: Internet and live-data access wrapper: search, open, click, find, PDF screenshots, image search, product search, sports, finance, weather, calculator, and time.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Open pages or URLs by ref_id, optionally at a line number.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Click link ids from an opened page.

parameters.name: find
parameters.description: Find a text pattern in an opened page.

parameters.name: screenshot
parameters.description: Take screenshot of a page in an opened PDF; pageno is zero-indexed.

parameters.name: product_query
parameters.description: Search or lookup retail products; restricted categories are unavailable.

parameters.name: sports
parameters.description: Fetch sports schedules or standings for supported leagues.

parameters.name: finance
parameters.description: Fetch current market data for equity, fund, crypto, or index tickers.

items.market: ISO 3166-3 country code, OTC, or empty for crypto

parameters.name: weather
parameters.description: Fetch weather forecast for specific locations.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Get current time for UTC offsets.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Search the internet for query strings, optionally with recency and domain filters.

returns.description: A bundle of source objects with reference ids such as turnXsearchY, turnXviewY, turnXfinanceY, turnXforecastY, turnXsportsY, turnXimageY, or turnXproductY. Some refs can be used by later open/click/find/screenshot calls or rendered as rich UI widgets.

top_level_tools.description: Search the user's File Library for uploaded files or file chunks. Current available source is file_library.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.description: One to five self-contained semantic/keyword search queries; must always be present.

parameters.name: source_filter
parameters.description: Non-empty source list; current hard constraint allows only file_library.

parameters.name: time_frame_filter
parameters.description: Optional upload-time filter for File Library searches.

returns.description: Ranked file snippets or navigation entries, with mclick pointers like 0:1 and file citation line markers when content is retrieved.

top_level_tools.description: Open file_search result pointers to expand file content, snippets, or multimodal file views.

parameters.name: pointers
parameters.description: Pointers returned by msearch, for example ['0:1','0:2'].

returns.description: Expanded file content, metadata, line-numbered snippets, and sometimes multimodal view data.

top_level_tools.description: Execute Python code in a stateful Jupyter-like kernel for private analysis, computation, data inspection, and file generation used internally by the assistant.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python source code sent as the tool body.

returns.description: stdout, stderr, exceptions, displayed values, and generated file side effects in the sandbox.

top_level_tools.description: Execute Python code whose outputs are visible to the user; used for charts, tables, and user-facing files.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python source code sent as the tool body.

returns.description: User-visible stdout, rendered plots/tables, and generated file artifacts.

top_level_tools.description: Get the user's current location and local time, or UTC time when location is unknown.

returns.description: Coarse location, local time, and timezone context when available.

top_level_tools.description: Retrieve user-specific personal context from prior interactions or linked context streams. The query must be self-contained.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Self-contained natural-language query describing the personal context needed.

returns.description: Relevant user-memory/context snippets and summaries when available.

top_level_tools.description: Read safe-to-share summaries of previous hidden reasoning messages when the user asks about prior scratchpad or reasoning.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of summary messages to read.

returns.description: A list of safe-to-share reasoning summaries, not raw private chain-of-thought JSON.

top_level_tools.description: Execute a command in the sandbox/container; can allocate an interactive pseudo-TTY if session_name is set.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Command and arguments to execute, for example ['bash','-lc','ls -lah'].

returns.description: stdout, stderr, exit status, and session metadata when applicable; file-system side effects may persist inside the sandbox.

top_level_tools.description: Send characters to an existing interactive exec session, then flush stdout/stderr after a delay.

parameters.name: session_name
parameters.description: Interactive session name created by container.exec.

returns.description: Incremental stdout/stderr emitted by the interactive session.

top_level_tools.description: Open an image file from the container for visual inspection. Absolute paths are required; supported formats include jpg, jpeg, png, and webp.

returns.description: Rendered image preview plus metadata as available.

top_level_tools.description: Download a file from a URL into the container filesystem.

returns.description: Download status and local file path when successful.

top_level_tools.description: List dynamic op resources and callable tools, including Figma and GitHub resources in the current session.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor; must be a next_cursor from a prior response.

returns.description: Resource names, callable tool paths, descriptions, and argument schemas. May include next_cursor for pagination.

top_level_tools.description: Invoke a dynamic op resource discovered by api_tool.list_resources.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full resource path returned by list_resources.

returns.description: Result object from the invoked resource; shape depends on the selected resource.

top_level_tools.description: Generate or edit images from the conversation context. It can use referenced images from the current conversation for image editing or style transfer when allowed.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Deprecated in the visible schema; normally pass null because instructions are inferred from context.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional output size in the visible schema.

parameters.name: transparent_background
parameters.description: Whether to generate a transparent background.

parameters.name: is_style_transfer
parameters.description: Whether the request asks for a stylistic transformation.

parameters.name: referenced_image_ids
parameters.description: Deprecated image reference field in the visible schema.

top_level_tools.observed_runtime_note: The runtime wrapper also accepted fields such as aspect_ratio and reference_image_paths in this session; these are treated as observed wrapper fields rather than stable top-level schema guarantees.

returns.description: Generated image preview and saved file path metadata.

top_level_tools.description: Long-term memory update interface. Disabled in the current session.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Would normally contain memory update content; unavailable here.

returns.description: No callable result because the tool is disabled.
